semantic.implementation: Use one semantic picture per editor with theme-specific sources and locale-aware asset names. The marketing page owns tab buttons, tab panels, illustrative-data caption, screenshot border, corner clipping and shadow in HTML/CSS. Keep the image undecorated; render copy and calls to action outside it.
semantic.notes: The parent builds responsive composition A and exposes the active editor through accessible tabs. Screenshots preserve actual product UI but are static illustrations of source sample files.

execution_order: Open source samples in the installed real editor bundle through the standard frame protocol.
Capture native dark UI and encode 2400x1500 WebP.
Preserve existing light raster bytes and attach exact committed origins.
Review the complete contact sheet and consume matching light/dark locale pairs.
limitations: Authenticated sample capture could not seed a document: the local preview API returned 503 storage_unavailable.
Fixture screenshots depict the actual installed renderer and source files; the fixture grants an empty AI panel and does not validate backend, authentication, save, customer data or AI execution.
Existing light rasters have exact committed origins; original capture timestamps and runtime sessions were not retained.
assumptions: The approved hero requires real editor screenshots as final image assets.
All report/deck metrics belong to fictional sample documents and must retain the page's illustrative-data label.
